item.title: pluton
item.description:

Managing encrypted backups across diverse storage providers with granular control remains a complex task for both beginners and advanced users.

item.title: laya
item.description:
## The Problem
The project addresses the need for fast, multilingual decision-making in applications like ticket routing, email classification, or structured data analysis. Traditional NLP approaches, which rely on text generation and parsing, are slow and prone to hallucinations—especially in low-latency environments. item.title: train llm from scratch
item.description:
## The Problem Training a large language model (LLM) from raw text to a usable assistant normally requires a stack of heavyweight libraries (`transformers`, `trl`, `peft`). This repo eliminates those dependencies and shows how to build the entire pipeline—tokenisation, transformer, loss, fine‑tuning, reward modelling, RL, and chat—in plain PyTorch. The goal is a single‑GPU trainable LLM that can be aligned for reasoning tasks without external tooling.
